premise_correction: The other 48 Tahoe-100M lines are already on the shared NFS: /mnt/S1/sdata/pubdata/Tahoe/Tahoe-100M (HF mirror, 3,388/3,388 expression shards = 337.6 GB, obs_metadata 2.3 GB, sample/drug/cell_line/gene metadata, pseudobulk_differential_expression 1,026 shards = 88.9 GB). Owner: hg (group sysmed, readable). No download is required for R3.

verification.shard_layout: each expression shard holds one plate (all 50 lines, ~60 wells, 28,225 cells)

options.what: Use Tahoe official pseudobulk DESeq2 (log2FC, padj) for all 50 lines; extract lfc matrix for ~5,000 genes x 65,218 line-drug-dose-plate conditions
options.cpu: one 16-CPU Slurm pass ~10 min (measured: summary pass 9.5 min, job 20326)
options.caveat: DESeq2 statistics not null-calibrated (no DMSO-vs-DMSO); lfc usable as target, padj not as response filter

options.what: Per-well raw-count pseudobulk for all 50 lines (sample x line, plus DMSO pseudo-wells), all 62,713 genes, one streaming pass over the local shards
options.cpu_estimate: ~95.6M cells; SNU-423 h5ad pass took 241 s for 1.5M cells on 4 CPUs (job 20327) -> ~4.3 CPU-h single stream; ~20-40 min wall with 16 parallel shard workers (estimate)
options.enables: chemCPA/linear/nearest-line/mean baselines and pseudobulk LOCO; same noise model as F4

options.what: Cell-level subset for distributional models (State/chemCPA cell-level): cap 100 cells per (line, well), all wells
Restricted cell-level subset chosen on training lines only: drug-doses strong (>=3x line-median Tahoe DE count) in >=10 of the 48 non-liver lines, plus all DMSO wells; cap 100 cells/(line, well)
options.caveat: selection uses non-liver lines only; SNU-423 numbers above are a descriptive check, not used for selection

options.what: Re-download from HF; cells of one line are spread over all shards, so a line subset still needs the full 337.6 GB scan (streaming possible: SNU-423 network extraction took 1 h 37 min). A plate subset is ~24 GB per plate (shard = plate). Pseudobulk DE only: 88.9 GB.

gpu_estimate: Pseudobulk models (A0/A1): CPU or 1 GPU, minutes-hours. Cell-level chemCPA on ~3-7M cells x 2,000 genes: 1 A100, several hours per run (estimate, not measured). State: pretrained Tahoe checkpoints may have seen SNU-423 (needs checking before any LOCO claim); training from scratch is multi-GPU scale.
leakage_rules: Hold out every SNU-423 treated well; SNU-423 DMSO cells may be used as the context input (separate regime)
Choose drugs/genes/hyperparameters on training lines (or a validation line such as HepG2/C3A) only
Report a same-well baseline (mean response of other lines in the same well) because all lines share well/plate technical effects
Do not use pretrained checkpoints trained on Tahoe-100M including SNU-423 for the 'unseen cell line' claim
